name: Farming
description: Farming word search puzzles gather field and barn English for adults and seniors — acre, barley, furrow, silo, pasture, orchard and calm harvest words — without agribusiness brands or licensed farm characters. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays practical and unhurried: corn, wheat, plow, rake, dawn chore and cream vocabulary many rural readers already know. This hub pairs well with Farm Animals and Garden when you want a longer countryside session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a morning fence walk.
